name: kit.voice
description: Makes a voice the brand's, as a new version numbered in the same statement, on top of the kit as it is now: a blank summary keeps the old one, a pair needs both words, a blank line goes. Two publishes at once cannot share a number.
sql:
with k as (select * from brandbase.brand_kits where brand_id = :brand),
next as (select brandbase.voice_edited(k.voice, :voice::jsonb) as voice from k),
version as (
  insert into brandbase.voice_versions (brand_id, n, by, note, voice, created_at)
  select :brand, coalesce((select max(n) from brandbase.voice_versions where brand_id = :brand), 0) + 1,
    (select coalesce(nullif(u.name, ''), u.email) from brandbase.users u where u.id = :actor),
    btrim(coalesce(:note, '')), next.voice, :now::timestamptz
  from next
  returning *
),
kit as (
  update brandbase.brand_kits x set voice = next.voice, version = x.version + 1, updated_at = now()
  from next where x.brand_id = :brand
  returning x.*
)
select jsonb_build_object('kit', brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(kit)) || jsonb_build_object('updatedAt', brandbase.iso(kit.updated_at)),
  'version', brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(v)) || jsonb_build_object('createdAt', brandbase.iso(v.created_at))) as result
from kit, version v
